[USER] User requested suggestions on how to actively listen and the impact of active listening.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To actively listen, focus on the speaker and pay attention to what they are saying.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid interrupting or jumping to conclusions before the speaker has finished speaking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When the speaker finishes, try to paraphrase or summarize what they said to show understanding and encourage them to continue.
